parts.name: Cabinet Base
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet base is the bottom structural part of the storage cabinet, made of plywood for stability and support.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the entire cabinet structure and bears the load of stored items.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Cabinet Door
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet door is a solid wood panel attached to the front of the cabinet, used to open and close the storage space.
parts.Functional_description: It provides access to the interior shelves and protects stored items from dust and view.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about hinges to open and close.

parts.name: Cabinet Frame
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet frame forms the main body of the storage cabinet, made of MDF for rigidity and smooth finish.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural integrity and houses the shelves and door.
parts.Movement_description: It is stationary and does not move during use.

parts.name: Shelf (Top)
parts.Basic_description: The top shelf is a horizontal board inside the cabinet, made of particle board.
parts.Functional_description: It supports items placed inside the cabinet and divides the storage space.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed or adjustable depending on design but generally remains stationary.

parts.name: Shelf (Middle)
parts.Basic_description: The middle shelf is a horizontal divider inside the cabinet, made of particle board.
parts.Functional_description: It provides additional storage levels for organizing items.
parts.Movement_description: It is typically fixed or adjustable but does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Shelf (Bottom)
parts.Basic_description: The bottom shelf is the lowest internal platform of the cabinet, made of particle board.
parts.Functional_description: It supports heavier items and contributes to the cabinet’s internal structure.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move during normal use.
